title.en: Word Is Law: The Seventh Night

tagline.zh: 自然语言立法 × 七日断案社交推理
tagline.en: Legislate in plain language, solve the case in seven days

description.zh: 你是头七之夜的判官：用一句话立法，言灵们必须服从法统；七日之内，从谎言与记忆的缝隙里断出真相。法典查重、言灵对话、世界反馈全部由大模型实时演算，你的每一句立法都会真实改写世界规则。
description.en: You are the judge of the seventh night: legislate in a single sentence and the spirits must obey; within seven days, tease the truth out of lies and memories. Statute dedup, spirit dialogue and world feedback are all computed live by the language model.

tagline.en: Type a line; the world obeys

description.zh: OriEra 引擎首个公开 demo：用自然语言向世界下达指令，观察实体如何听懂合并、否定与分拨。内置自动演奏谱面（?demo=1），无 Key 也能看完整演出。
description.en: The engine's first public demo: issue commands in natural language and watch entities understand merging, negation and dispatch. A self-playing score (?demo=1) runs the full show without any key.

tagline.zh: 三个 NPC 记得你说过的每一句话
tagline.en: Three NPCs who remember every word you say

description.zh: 检索式长期记忆 + 导演系统的旗舰样例：与阿哲、小满、雨枝闲聊，你的插话会推动剧情节拍，咖啡馆后墙的挂画随故事热替换。Key 存在你自己的浏览器里，对话记录永不离开本机。
description.en: The flagship sample for retrievable long-term memory plus a director system: chat with three regulars, your interjections push the story beats, and the wall art hot-swaps as the plot moves. Your key stays in your own browser; conversations never leave the machine.

tagline.en: Dress the whole hall with one sentence

description.zh: 生成式表达内生的示范作：输入一个主题，穹顶、三张海报与展台贴图全部实时生成并热替换；关掉生成器，程序化确定性贴图照样兜底，展厅永不挂黑。
description.en: The showpiece of generative expression built into the engine: type a theme and the dome, three posters and plinth textures are generated and hot-swapped live. Switch the generator off and deterministic procedural textures take over — the hall never goes dark.

description.zh: 社区首个外部贡献 demo（@airbate，PR #53）：咖啡馆里被记住的话画成一片星图，每颗星是一句被记下的句子。完全离线。
description.en: The first community-contributed demo (@airbate, PR #53): remembered lines from the café become a field of stars, one star per sentence. Fully offline.

tagline.zh: 十一层架构的最小切片
tagline.en: The smallest slice of the eleven layers

description.zh: 引擎最小可跑样例：一个三角形、一条命令流。单文件、零依赖、完全离线——适合作为阅读源码前的第一站。
description.en: The minimal runnable sample: one triangle, one command stream. A single self-contained file, zero dependencies, fully offline — the right first stop before reading the source.

tagline.zh: 十万粒子的 WebGPU 压测场
tagline.en: A WebGPU stress field of a hundred thousand particles

description.zh: L1 位图与 L5 质量调速的视觉压测：十万级粒子在 WebGPU 计算管线里随命令流起舞。需要支持 WebGPU 的浏览器（Chrome / Edge 113+），完全离线。
description.en: A visual stress test of the L1 bitmap and L5 quality governor: a hundred thousand particles dance through a WebGPU compute pipeline under command flow. Needs a WebGPU-capable browser (Chrome / Edge 113+). Fully offline.

tagline.en: All eleven layers on one page

description.zh: 从 L1 位图到 L9 认知系统的全层联演：调度、物理、生成、记忆在同一帧预算下协同运行。自动循环讲解，完全离线。
description.en: Every layer from the L1 bitmap to the L9 cognition stack cooperating inside one frame budget: scheduling, physics, generation and memory in concert. Runs a narrated loop, fully offline.

tagline.en: She forgot the ledger, not you

description.zh: 陪伴赛道样板间：把 60 条记忆上限变成玩法——记忆满了就要「结账」遗忘，而哪些被记住、哪些被放下，构成了这个故事全部的温柔与锋利。
description.en: The companion-track sample room: a 60-memory capacity turned into gameplay — when memory fills up, something must be checked out and forgotten. What is kept and what is let go is where the story's tenderness and teeth both live.

tagline.en: One street, two sets of rules

description.zh: 数字孪生赛道样板间：政策反事实推演——同一条街在两种政策下各自演化，首分岔日的逐帧归因让「如果当初」变成可检验的实验。
description.en: The digital-twin sample room: policy counterfactuals — the same street evolves under two policies, and frame-level attribution of the first divergence day turns "what if" into a checkable experiment.

tagline.en: One command, one shot — every frame keeps its negative

description.zh: AIGC 赛道样板间：口头调度生成镜头，每个 checkpoint 都可回放 diff——生成的每一帧都留有可审计的底片。
description.en: The AIGC sample room: direct shots by voice, replay any checkpoint as a diff — every generated frame keeps an auditable negative.

description.zh: 具身智能赛道样板间：任务库出题 → 具身执行 → 逐帧复演校验。预算真实扣账、易碎约束真实判定、state_hash 复演一手不差——确定性的活证据。
description.en: The embodied-AI sample room: draw a task from the library, let the agent run it, then rerun it frame by frame. Budgets really deduct, fragile constraints really bite, and the state_hash replay matches to the frame — determinism as living proof.

tagline.zh: 每一帧教学决策都可审计

description.zh: 教育赛道样板间：BKT 掌握概率实时可见，辅导决策逐帧留痕、可回放审计——给家长看得懂的透明，给学生带得走的掌握度。
description.en: The education sample room: BKT mastery probabilities visible in real time, every tutoring decision logged and replayable — transparency parents can read, mastery students can take home.

description.zh: 影视预演赛道样板间：口头调度生成镜头与分镜卡；无 Key 或生成不可用时诚实降级为确定性分镜卡——预演永远开得了机。
description.en: The film-previz sample room: direct shots verbally and generate boards; when no key is present it degrades honestly to deterministic boards — previz that always rolls.

tagline.zh: 面对复现危机的实验台
tagline.en: A bench built for the replication crisis

description.zh: 科学仿真赛道样板间：每一次模型调用全留痕，实验流程可复演、可检验——给仿真一个对得上号的实验记录本。
description.en: The scientific-simulation sample room: every model call is fully logged, every experiment replayable and checkable — a lab notebook that actually reconciles.
